title: Melania Trump and robot: First lady enters White House summit with walking, talking robot Figure 03
key_facts: On Wednesday 30 Sep 2026 Melania Trump walked into the White House East Room beside Figure 03, a humanoid robot made by the US company Figure.
It was day two of her international technology summit, with spouses of leaders from 45 nations and representatives of 28 tech companies.
The robot greeted guests in several languages, waved, said it was 'a humanoid built in the United States of America', then walked back out along a corridor.
The first lady called it her 'first American-made humanoid guest in the White House'.
The summit is part of her 'Fostering the Future Together' initiative launched in September at the UN General Assembly; sessions covered AI, education technology, digital literacy and online safety.
Ukraine's Olena Zelenska and Israel's Sara Netanyahu were among the spouses present.
quote_evidence: Named "Figure 03," the shiny black and white robot strolled side by side with Mrs. Trump into the East Room for the second day of her international technology summit
"I'm Figure 03, a humanoid built in the United States of America," it said.
The robot then turned and walked back down a White House corridor out of the room.
why_it_matters_hint: A humanoid robot walked and spoke unaided at a White House event, a public showcase for US-made humanoids.
notes: Event was Wednesday 30 Sep 2026, before the 3 Oct window; ABC7 text has an AP-style Washington dateline but no wire credit visible, so credited to ABC7. Whether the robot was remotely operated is not stated.
